name: Progress bar
looksLike: bar that fills up as a file uploads
horizontal strip showing how much is finished
loading line with a percentage completed
definition: A bar that shows how much of a task is complete, or indicates ongoing work when the total is unknown.

notConfusedWith.difference: Reserves space for incoming content without measuring completion.

prompts.short: Add a labeled progress bar showing task completion and a visible percentage.
prompts.detailed: Add a native progress element with an accessible label and visible percentage text. Update its value as work completes. Omit value when completion is unknown, and announce major status changes without announcing every percentage update.

a11yNotes: Give the progress element an accessible label
Expose the value and maximum; omit value for unknown progress
Announce meaningful status changes without excessive live updates
